conbody.p: You can switch the temperature mode from Centigrade to Fahrenheit as follows:

li.p: Select SettingsGeneralUnitsTemperature on the infotainment system.

conbody.p: The display will change from Centigrade to Fahrenheit, or from Fahrenheit to Centigrade. If the battery has been discharged or disconnected, the temperature mode display will reset to Centigrade.
